input.strategy_title: Idle resource reporting in the web console
input.strategy_markdown:
## Problem Statement

Cluster administrators cannot see which resources are sitting idle: workbenches
nobody has touched in weeks keep their volumes and reservations, and old
pipeline runs accumulate storage. Admins ask for a single report in the RHOAI
web console showing idle and stale resources per project so they can reclaim
capacity with confidence. The notebook controller already tracks last-activity
timestamps, and Kubeflow Pipelines retains run completion metadata — the data
exists; it is just not surfaced anywhere.

## High-Level Requirements

| ID | Priority | Requirement |
|-------|----------|-------------|
| HLR-1 | P1 | The web console shows a per-project idle-workbench report (last activity, owner, reserved resources), sourced from the notebook controller's activity tracking. |
| HLR-2 | P1 | The web console shows a stale pipeline-run report (completed runs older than a configurable age with retained artifacts), sourced from Kubeflow Pipelines run metadata. |
| HLR-3 | P2 | Administrators can export either report as CSV. |
| HLR-4 | P2 | Documentation explains the reports and safe reclamation steps. |

## Affected Components

- RHOAI web console
- Notebook controller
- Kubeflow Pipelines

## Out of Scope

- Automated reclamation or deletion of idle resources
- Cost/chargeback calculations

## Open Questions

None.

# Per-project idle and stale resource reports in the RHOAI web console

## Description

This epic delivers a per-project idle and stale resource report view in the
RHOAI web console, giving cluster administrators visibility into resources
that are sitting idle: workbenches nobody has touched in weeks that keep
their volumes and reservations, and old pipeline runs that accumulate stored
artifacts. The report surfaces, per project, an idle-workbench section
(last activity, owner, reserved resources) sourced from the notebook
controller's activity tracking, and a stale pipeline-run section (completed
runs older than a configurable age with retained artifacts) sourced from
Kubeflow Pipelines run metadata. Both report sections are exportable as CSV
so administrators can reclaim capacity with confidence.

## Scope

- Add a per-project report surface in the web console that shows idle and stale resources.
- Idle-workbench report section: per workbench, show last activity (sourced from the notebook controller's activity tracking), owner, and reserved resources (volumes and reservations).
- Stale pipeline-run report section: list completed pipeline runs older than a configurable age threshold that retain artifacts, sourced from Kubeflow Pipelines run metadata.
- Make the stale-run age threshold configurable.
- CSV export of either report (idle-workbench report and stale pipeline-run report).
- Validate that the report data correctly reflects the two passive data sources: the notebook controller's last-activity tracking and Kubeflow Pipelines run completion metadata (no code changes to those components are in scope).
- No automated reclamation or deletion of idle resources, and no cost/chargeback calculations (out of scope per strategy).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given a project with workbenches of varying activity, when an administrator opens the idle-workbench report, then each workbench is listed with its last activity, owner, and reserved resources, and the last-activity values match the notebook controller's activity tracking.
- Given a project with completed pipeline runs, when an administrator opens the stale pipeline-run report, then runs completed before the configured age threshold are listed with their retained artifacts, and the listing matches Kubeflow Pipelines run metadata.
- Given the configurable age threshold, when an administrator changes it, then the stale pipeline-run report reflects the new threshold.
- Given either report, when an administrator triggers CSV export, then a CSV file is produced containing the report's rows and columns.
- Given the report view, when an administrator reviews it, then it contains no reclamation or deletion actions (out of scope).

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-1 (P1): per-project idle-workbench report (last activity, owner, reserved resources) sourced from notebook-controller activity tracking.
- HLR-2 (P1): stale pipeline-run report (completed runs older than a configurable age with retained artifacts) sourced from Kubeflow Pipelines run metadata.
- HLR-3 (P2, bundled): CSV export of either report — bundled because it operates on the same report surfaces and data built for HLR-1/HLR-2.

# Document the idle/stale resource reports and safe reclamation steps

## Description

This epic delivers Red Hat documentation explaining the new per-project
idle and stale resource reports in the RHOAI web console: what each report
shows (idle workbenches with last activity, owner, and reserved resources;
stale pipeline runs older than a configurable age with retained artifacts),
how to export them as CSV, and the safe manual steps an administrator can
take to reclaim capacity based on the reports.

## Scope

- A documentation topic introducing the idle and stale resource reports and the administrator problem they solve (reclaiming capacity with confidence).
- Guidance on reading each report section: idle-workbench entries (last activity, owner, reserved resources) and stale pipeline-run entries (completed runs older than the configurable age with retained artifacts).
- Instructions for configuring the stale-run age threshold.
- Instructions for exporting either report as CSV.
- Documented safe reclamation steps for idle workbenches and stale pipeline runs, including appropriate cautions (the platform performs no automated reclamation or deletion).
- Content outline:
  1. Overview: why idle/stale resource reporting exists
  2. Viewing the idle-workbench report
  3. Viewing the stale pipeline-run report and configuring the age threshold
  4. Exporting reports as CSV
  5. Safe reclamation steps and cautions

## Acceptance Criteria

- Published documentation topics exist that explain both reports, the configurable age threshold, CSV export, and safe reclamation steps.
- Documentation is technically reviewed against the implemented reports and accurately reflects the shipped behavior (fields shown, threshold configuration, export output).
- Reclamation guidance is reviewed for safety and clearly states that reclamation is manual (no automated deletion).

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-4 (P2): documentation explains the reports and safe reclamation steps.
